While we have included the codes, there isn't enough evidence to say the codes give any more information to narrow down what the Hidden is for a specific visible, especially as they often still overlap.

Rather than the codes, it seems the assortments are determined by the "Try me" sample on the boxes. Unfortunately, as these are often removed (and Clickeez can be moved around), it can still be hard to say for sure unless you find an untouched box. :(

Similarly, the Limited Editions seem to just be random chance as the Hidden in any type, replacing one of the usual patterns. The_Lucky_Bunny has been found in 2-Packs, 5-Packs, and the Keyboard Packs.
